# GeTopFloor

> GeTopFloor is an interactive 3D virtual skyscraper and live attention market. Startups and founders claim floors on the digital tower to showcase their companies, earn backlinks, and gain high-intent visibility from founders and investors worldwide.

## Overview
- **Website**: https://getopfloor.com
- **Type**: Interactive 3D WebGL Platform / Startup Discovery / Digital Sponsorship
- **Pricing**: Dynamic starting from ₹50 INR (one-time placement fee)
- **Fulfillment**: 100% instant, automated digital delivery upon checkout
- **Payment Provider**: Authorized PCI-DSS Compliant Payment Gateways (Cards, UPI, NetBanking)

## Core Concepts

### 1. The Unlimited 3D Skyscraper
GeTopFloor features a dynamically growing virtual skyscraper supporting unlimited claimed floors rendered in high-performance Three.js 3D WebGL.
- **Penthouse Floor #1**: The summit of the skyscraper, commanding maximum visibility, attention, and traffic.
- **Dynamic Floor Placement Hierarchy**: Any founder can boost their placement to claim Floor #1. When a new company claims Floor #1, all existing floors shift down one rank atomically in PostgreSQL.
- **Permanent Claim Placement**: Every claimed floor remains preserved on the skyscraper and accessible as the building grows infinitely.

### 3. Zero-Login Support & Updates
GeTopFloor operates without accounts or passwords:
- **View Floor**: Retrieve live floor rank, price paid, and click impressions.
- **Update Details**: Request company title, website destination URL, tagline, category, description, and logo updates via verified email support.
- **Vacate Floor**: Request floor reset or voluntary removal anytime.

## API Endpoints
- `POST /api/checkout`: Initiates Dodo Payments checkout session with custom amount and return URL.
- `GET /api/checkout/verify`: Verifies Dodo Payment status and assigns dynamic skyscraper rank.
- `POST /api/upload`: Authenticated logo upload to Vercel Blob Storage CDN.
